about_the_game:
Welcome to Aetheria, a vibrant fantasy world where villagers complain about sheep, wizards throw tantrums, and some grandmas will really beat you with sticks if you mess with their knitting circle.

This isn’t another "silent hero saves the kingdom" story. You are Fayme, a loudmouth whose tongue is deadlier than any blade. Win battles with swords, spells, and sharp insults. Trash-talk a wizard mid-fireball and walk away victorious - or make them so mad they turn you into ashes.

So... fight with fists, fight with fire, or fight with words. Either way, someone’s leaving embarrassed. Hopefully not you.

Key Features:

  • Combat Banter: Use your wit to provoke, confuse, scare, or even calm down your enemies. Every insult is a gamble, but the payoff can be huge.

  • Fluid Combat: Punches, kicks, weapons, spells, dodges, parries, and ridiculous finishers.

  • Enemies With Feelings: Rage, fear, pride, vanity - exploit their mood swings to gain the upper hand.

  • Elemental Magic: Master powerful spells of fire, air, water, and earth. They look spectacular (and occasionally backfire).

  • Stylized Fantasy World: Explore a quirky land full of eccentric characters and sarcastic quests. Speak or fight - the choice is yours.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 64-bit, Service Pack 1
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2300, 2.8 GHz or AMD FX-6300, 3.5 GHz
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 460 GTX, 1 GB or AMD Radeon 6870 HD, 1 GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device
  • Additional Notes: Controller support: Microsoft Xbox 360® Controller for Windows® (or equivalent) recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-7700, 3.6 GHz or AMD Ryzen 7 3700X, 3.6GHz
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 3 GB or AMD Radeon RX 580 4 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device
  • Additional Notes: Controller support: Microsoft Xbox 360® Controller for Windows® (or equivalent) recommended

short_description: Your tongue can be deadlier than your blade. Forget the silent hero - you’re Fayme, a loudmouth who can trash-talk a wizard mid-fireball and still live to tell the tale. In this unique fantasy adventure, you’ll speak as much as you fight.
